name: Experimental Modal Analysis
description: The theoretical basis of modal analysis; modal analysis of single and multi-degree of freedom undamped and damped systems; characteristics of FRFs; signal processing for modal analysis; FRF measurement using impact testing; impact hammer, accelerometers; LDV; vibration shaker; force transducers; FRF measurement using shaker testing; shaker-structure interaction; measurement with various excitation signals; modal parameter estimation; SDOF methods; MDOF methods; frequency domain and time domain methods; mode indicator functions; phase resonance testing; EMA applications; dynamic design; model updating; structural dynamic modification; force identification; response simulation; practicals on modal testing using an impact hammer, modal testing using a shaker, modal parameter estimation, SDM and model validation and updating.
